version.author: Chmod666music
version.changelog: Add filtered Stereo and Ping Pong delay with independent channel times. Stabilize Shimmer feedback and add transparent output peak protection. Add octave-up Shimmer mode with dual-head pitch-shifted feedback. Add stereo Room and Hall Cloud Reverb with size, decay, and damping. Add adjustable per-grain Attack and Release envelopes. Replace the factory library with 130 CC0 sounds created by REVERBERA. Add per-grain Pitch Spread in semitones. Initial public beta ReaPack release.
